limitations: Contract mappings resolve to registry provenance review-accepted registry identities and activation histories; incentives evidence review accepted the bounded protocol model, but public reader and writer support remain absent.
The CL gauge factory and implementation identities added by pool evidence review are accepted Contract registry records; pool and incentives public operations remain separately gated.
Gauge instances, weights, claimability, reward tokens, depositor identity, and allowlists are volatile state.

gaugeTypes.creation: A caller supplies an approved pool factory and a pool recognized by that factory. Non-governor callers require both pool tokens to be voter-whitelisted. The registry-selected gauge and voting-reward factories create a staking gauge plus fee and bribe rewards.
Governor-only; fee reward token is the vault yield token.
Governor-only; created without fee reward tokens.
The veBTC owner/approved caller may create one gauge for an existing unexpired normal or managed veBTC NFT through an approved factory, optionally supplying whitelisted bribes.

emissionAllocation.globalIndex: On splitter notification: ratio = floor(amount * 1e18 / max(totalWeight, 1)); add ratio to global index only when ratio > 0.
emissionAllocation.gaugeAccrual: On update: delta = globalIndex - gaugeSupplyIndex; share = floor(poolWeight * delta / 1e18). A live gauge accrues share; a killed gauge returns share to the splitter.
emissionAllocation.distribution: Before distribution the voter asks the splitter to update its period, updates the gauge accrual, and notifies the gauge only when claimable > gauge.left() and claimable > 604800 raw reward-token units.
emissionAllocation.kill: Emergency council may kill a live gauge; already claimable rewards are returned to the splitter. The council may revive a killed PoolsVoter gauge.

claims.stakingRewards: claimRewards calls each supplied gauge's getReward for the caller.
claims.feeAndBribeRewards: The veNFT owner or approved caller may invoke claimFees, claimBribes, or claimFeesAndBribes for explicit reward-contract and token arrays.
claims.securityBoundary: Knowledge does not infer safe reward-contract/token arrays from user input. Future writers must resolve them from the current gauge graph and simulate the exact call.

analyticsBoundary: Gauge weight and index allocation are protocol accounting facts.
Reward density, APR, APY, future emissions, token price, and user yield require additional state and assumptions and are not canonical protocol outputs.
A displayed APY must never be used as an input to construct a vote, claim, or distribution transaction.

clPositionBoundary.rule: The pools module owns CL NFT depositor/contract-owner identity and active-versus-staked-versus-position liquidity. This incentives record owns emission allocation and reward claims; neither boundary may substitute its liquidity or owner meaning for the other.
